checkpoints.definition: Setup. Static angles here are the median of the whole address hold, not one frame.
checkpoints.label: Address

checkpoints.definition: Club shaft parallel to the ground in the takeaway.
checkpoints.label: Backswing — bottom

checkpoints.definition: Lead arm parallel to the ground in the backswing.
checkpoints.label: Backswing — middle

checkpoints.definition: Top of the backswing: highest grip before the change of direction.
checkpoints.label: Backswing — top

checkpoints.definition: Lead arm parallel to the ground on the way down.
checkpoints.label: Downswing — top

checkpoints.basis: proxy: grip descends past trail-hip height
checkpoints.definition: Club shaft parallel to the ground on the way down — the delivery position.
checkpoints.label: Downswing — middle

checkpoints.definition: Club shaft parallel to the ground after impact.
checkpoints.label: Follow-through — middle

checkpoints.definition: Trail arm parallel to the ground in the follow-through — the mirror of P3.
checkpoints.label: Follow-through — top

checkpoints.definition: Finish: motion has decayed and the hands are high.
checkpoints.label: Finish

ball_direction.basis: hands sit toward the ball of the hip line at address

glossary.early_extension_note: positive = pelvis moved toward the ball, resolved from where the hands sit at address (see ball_direction)
glossary.posture_note: one curvature value; cannot separate thoracic from lumbar, and the scale is unvalidated

sides.note: lead = side closest to the target; not the side facing the camera

units: angles in degrees; sway/lift in golfer body-heights
